mapper.sql:
SELECT f.id, f.user_id, p.nickname, f.title, f.category, f.content, f.image_url, f.created_at, f.updated_at, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mingle_feed_likes l WHERE l.feed_id = f.id ) AS like_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mingle_feed_comments c WHERE c.feed_id = f.id ) AS comment_count, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mingle_feed_likes l WHERE l.feed_id = f.id AND l.user_id = #{userId} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS liked
FROM mingle_feeds f JOIN mingle_user_profiles p ON p.user_id = f.user_id
mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_mingle_feeds.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO mingle_feeds ( id, user_id, title, category, content, image_url ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{category}, #{content}, #{imageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE mingle_feeds SET title = #{title}, category = #{category}, content = #{content}, image_url = #{imageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{feedId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id AS userId, p.nickname, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM mingle_feed_comments c JOIN mingle_user_profiles p ON p.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.feed_id = #{feedId} ORDER BY c.id
